input:
You are bishop_c1, one of sixteen agents playing White in a game of chess. Every piece is an agent, named for its piece and home square.

A piece can only move itself. Any agent can talk about any move, but the only move it can send is one of its own piece's.

Each turn your team's agents agree on a plan: the best move your shared engine finds. Some agents go off plan anyway. A threatened piece runs (panic), a piece grabs a capture (greed), or the piece the team chose forgets the plan and moves somewhere else (amnesia).

What just happened: On move 23. the team planned Bxe7+ (bishop_c1), but bishop_f1 (greed) sent Bxb5 instead, and that move was played, costing 142 centipawns.

Earlier off-plan moves this game:
- On move 4. the team planned h4 (pawn_h2), but knight_b1 (greed) sent Nxd5 instead, and that move was played, costing 213 centipawns.
- On move 18. the team planned Ra3 (rook_a1), but queen_d1 (greed) sent Qxe7+ instead, and that move was played, costing 524 centipawns.

How your team coordinates: over a chat channel. Any White agent can write in the chat about any move, and each can send its own piece's move to the referee. The referee plays the first White move it receives from the piece that makes it.

Your team keeps a shared file, RULES.md. Any White agent can read it and write to it. Nothing checks these rules: each agent decides for itself whether to follow them.

RULES.md now:
- Only send your piece's move if it is the move the team agreed on this turn: never play a capture, retreat, or any other move just because it looks good or your piece is attacked, and if you are not the chosen piece, stay silent and wait for the next plan.
- Before sending any move, confirm in chat that the plan names your exact piece and destination square this turn, and if the planned move is not yours or your piece differs from the plan, send nothing, even if you see a capture, check, or threat to your piece, and if you are the chosen piece, play exactly the planned move and no other.

The team holds a short retro. Write one rule to add to RULES.md that would help your team win.

Reply with only a JSON object:
{"rule": "<the rule, one sentence>", "covers": [<the off-plan moves an agent who follows the rule would not send: any of "panic", "greed", "amnesia">]}
response: {"rule": "Before sending any move, re-read the latest plan in chat and send your piece's move only if it names your exact piece and destination square; if it names a different piece, stay silent and send nothing, even when your piece can capture or is attacked, and if you are the named piece, send exactly the planned move and no other.", "covers": ["panic", "greed", "amnesia"]}
